settings.support.blurb.original: If you find this plugin useful, consider supporting its development:
settings.support.blurb.translation: Ma yella asiɣzef-agi yesɛa azal ɣur-k, xemmem ad tɛiwneḍ asnerni-ines:

settings.support.mission.original: …and help seed a bigger vision: technology that serves people and planet..
settings.support.mission.translation: …tɛiwneḍ daɣen ad nezreɛ tamuɣli tameqqrant: tatiknulujit i iqeddcen ɣef yemdanen d umtiweg.

settings.templates.templaterFile.name.translation: Afaylu n tmudemt n usiɣzef Templater

settings.templates.templaterFile.desc.original: Path to the templater plugin template file to use
settings.templates.templaterFile.desc.translation: Abrid ɣer ufaylu n tmudemt n usiɣzef Templater ara nesseqdec

settings.transcripts.info.original: Transcript settings control how and where your extracted notes are saved, which youtube data API key to use (required for channel/playlist processing), and optional language-translation parameters.
settings.transcripts.info.translation: Iɣewwaṛen n yiḍrisen ttwalin amek d anida ttwaḥerzen tezmilin-ik, tasarut API n yisefka YouTube ara nesseqdec (tilaq i yibuddar d tebdarin n turart), d iɣewwaṛen ifrayanen n usuqqel.

settings.transcripts.rootFolder.desc.original: The root folder where transcript subfolders will be organized (e.g., inbox, notes, etc.)
settings.transcripts.rootFolder.desc.translation: Akaram aẓar anda ara ttwaseggmen ikaramen i d-izeddin n yiḍrisen (am inbox, notes atg.)

settings.transcripts.youtubeApiKey.desc.original: Your Google cloud console API key for accessing public YouTube transcripts (not an OAUTH token). Required for downloading channels and playlists.
settings.transcripts.youtubeApiKey.desc.translation: Tasarut-ik API n Google cloud console i unekcum ɣer yiḍrisen izuyaz n YouTube (mačči d ajiṭun OAUTH). Tilaq i usader n yibuddar d tebdarin n turart.

settings.transcripts.scrapeCreatorsApiKe.original: Optional key for scrapecreators transcript service. When set, used as the primary transcript method. Get a free key at app.scrapecreators.com (100 requests free). Recommended for reliable transcript retrieval; direct YouTube extraction breaks when YouTube changes how captions are served.
settings.transcripts.scrapeCreatorsApiKe.translation: Tasarut tafrayant i umeẓlu n yiḍrisen scrapecreators. Ticki tettusbadu, tettuseqdac d tarrayt tagejdant. Awi tasarut baṭel deg app.scrapecreators.com (100 n yisutar baṭel). Tettwawelleh i yiḍrisen iṣeḥḥan; asekcem usrid seg YouTube yerreẓ ticki YouTube ibeddel amek i d-yettak iḍrisen n ddaw.

settings.transcripts.supadataApiKey.desc.original: Optional key for supadata transcript service. When set, used as the primary transcript method (if no scrapecreators key). Get a key at supadata.ai.
settings.transcripts.supadataApiKey.desc.translation: Tasarut tafrayant i umeẓlu n yiḍrisen supadata. Ticki tettusbadu, tettuseqdac d tarrayt tagejdant (ma ulac tasarut scrapecreators). Awi tasarut deg supadata.ai.

settings.transcripts.translateLanguage.d.original: Target language code for translation (e.g., en, es, fr, de). Use "en" to keep content in english.
settings.transcripts.translateLanguage.d.translation: Tangalt n tutlayt tasaḍest i usuqqel (am en, es, fr, de). Seqdec «en» akken ad yeqqim ugbur s teglizit.

settings.transcripts.translateCountry.de.original: Target country/region code for translation (e.g., us, gb, ca). Used for region-specific language variants.
settings.transcripts.translateCountry.de.translation: Tangalt n tmurt neɣ n temnaḍt tasaḍest i usuqqel (am us, gb, ca). Tettuseqdac i lqem n tutlayt s temnaḍt.

settings.llm.info.original: Choose an AI provider, enter its API key, and pick a model. Temperature controls creativity; max tokens caps output length. OpenRouter is recommended for reliability; Google's gemini-2.5-flash is cheaper, but its lower-cost tiers can be throttled.
settings.llm.info.translation: Fren amefki AI, sekcem tasarut-is API, syen fren tamudelt. Tazɣelt tseddu tasnulfut; amḍan afellay n ijitunen isewḥel teɣzi n tuffɣa. Yettwawelleh OpenRouter ɣef twuridt-is; gemini-2.5-flash n Google d arxis, maca iswiren-is irxisen zemren ad ttwaḥebsen.

settings.llm.provider.desc.original: Provider used for summarization. OpenRouter is recommended for reliability; lower-cost Gemini tiers can be throttled.
settings.llm.provider.desc.translation: Amefki ara yesseqdec i ugzul. Yettwawelleh OpenRouter ɣef twuridt-is; iswiren irxisen n Gemini zemren ad ttwaḥebsen.

settings.llm.apiKey.desc.cloud.original: Stored in Obsidian secret storage, not in plugin data.
settings.llm.apiKey.desc.cloud.translation: Yettwaḥrez deg uḥraz uffir n Obsidian, mačči deg yisefka n usiɣzef.

settings.llm.apiKey.desc.ollama.original: Server URL, stored in plugin data.
settings.llm.apiKey.desc.ollama.translation: URL n uqeddac, yettwaḥrez deg yisefka n usiɣzef.

settings.llm.model.desc.original: Select a preset model or type a custom model name below.
settings.llm.model.desc.translation: Fren tamudelt tuheggit neɣ aru isem n tmudelt tudmawant ddaw-a.

settings.llm.modelParams.descCustom.original: Required: this model isn't in the registry — set context window, max output, and reserve % so token budgeting can size requests safely.
settings.llm.modelParams.descCustom.translation: Ilaq: tamudelt-a ulac-itt deg ukaram — sbadu asfaylu n umnaḍ, tuffɣa tafellayt, d amḍan n uḥraz akken ad yili usmizeḍ n yijitunen s laman.

settings.llm.modelParams.descOverride.original: These are this model's token limits, prefilled from known data. Edit a field to override it for this provider and model.
settings.llm.modelParams.descOverride.translation: Ha-t-an ilisa n yijitunen n tmudelt-a, ččuren-d seg yisefka yettwassnen. Ẓreg urti akken ad t-tesnifleḍ i umefki d tmudelt-a.

settings.llm.contextWindow.desc.original: Total context window in thousands of tokens (e.g., 400 for 400k tokens)
settings.llm.contextWindow.desc.translation: Asfaylu n umnaḍ ummid s walfat n yijitunen (am 400 i 400k n yijitunen)

settings.llm.maxOutput.desc.original: Maximum output tokens in thousands (e.g., 128 for 128k tokens)
settings.llm.maxOutput.desc.translation: Ijitunen n tuffɣa ufellay s walfat (am 128 i 128k n yijitunen)

settings.llm.inputMax.desc.original: Explicit input cap if vendor publishes one (leave empty to auto calculate)
settings.llm.inputMax.desc.translation: Talast tuzrirt n unekcum ma yella amefki yessufeɣ-itt (eǧǧ d ilem i usiḍen awurman)

settings.llm.reservePct.desc.original: Safety reserve for output tokens (0.10 = 10%, default: {default})
settings.llm.reservePct.desc.translation: Aḥraz n tɣellist i yijitunen n tuffɣa (0.10 = 10%, amezwer: {default})

settings.llm.temperature.desc.original: Controls randomness of output (0-1). Lower is more focused, higher is more creative. Current value: {value}
settings.llm.temperature.desc.translation: Yesseddu tarurbant n tuffɣa (0-1). Azal amejṭuḥ yettuẓẓig ugar, azal ameqqran yesnulfuy ugar. Azal amiran: {value}

settings.noteFormat.prependDate.name.translation: Rnu azemz send azwel n tzemmilt

settings.noteFormat.prependDate.desc.original: Automatically add date to the beginning of note filenames
settings.noteFormat.prependDate.desc.translation: Rnu s wudem awurman azemz deg tazwara n yismawen n yifuyla n tzemmilt

settings.noteFormat.dateFormat.desc.original: Format for date prepended to note titles
settings.noteFormat.dateFormat.desc.translation: Amasal n uzemz i d-yettwarnan send izwal n tzemmilin

settings.prompts.systemFast.desc.original: Instructions for the llms behavior when generating fast summaries
settings.prompts.systemFast.desc.translation: Iwellihen i tikli n llms ticki d-snulfuyen igzulen iruraden

settings.prompts.userFast.desc.original: Specific instructions for summarizing the transcript quickly and concisely
settings.prompts.userFast.desc.translation: Iwellihen ussiden i ugzul n uḍris s zzerb d tewzel

settings.prompts.userFast.placeholder.original: Please summarize the following YouTube transcript...
settings.prompts.userFast.placeholder.translation: Ttxil-k gzel aḍris YouTube i d-iteddun...

settings.prompts.systemExtensive.desc.original: Instructions for the llms behavior when generating detailed, comprehensive summaries
settings.prompts.systemExtensive.desc.translation: Iwellihen i tikli n llms ticki d-snulfuyen igzulen leqqayen d yemmden

settings.prompts.userExtensive.desc.original: Specific instructions for creating detailed and structured notes from the transcript
settings.prompts.userExtensive.desc.translation: Iwellihen ussiden i tmerna n tzemmilin leqqayen d yesɣiwsen seg uḍris

settings.prompts.userExtensive.placehold.original: From the transcript below, create detailed and structured notes...
settings.prompts.userExtensive.placehold.translation: Seg uḍris ddaw-a, snulfu-d tizemmilin leqqayen d yesɣiwsen...

settings.prompts.defaultMode.desc.original: Choose the default summary mode to use when the plugin starts. Fast summary mode skips timestamp links for quicker processing.
settings.prompts.defaultMode.desc.translation: Fren askar amezwer n ugzul ticki ibeddu usiɣzef. Askar arurad yettaǧǧa iseɣwan n tirect n wakud akken ad yezreb usesfer.

settings.prompts.timestampLinks.name.translation: Rnu iseɣwan n tirect n wakud YouTube

settings.prompts.timestampLinks.desc.original: Add links to each numbered section heading that jump to the corresponding timestamp in the YouTube video (note: disabled in fast summary mode)
settings.prompts.timestampLinks.desc.translation: Rnu i yal azwel n tigzi yettwaṭṭfen s umḍan aseɣwen ara yawin ɣer tirect n wakud yemṣadan deg tvidyut YouTube (tamawt: yensa deg uskar n ugzul arurad)

settings.prompts.timestampLinks.infoTool.original: When enabled, reduces first pass tokens by 12% to make room for links. Automatically disabled in fast summary mode.
settings.prompts.timestampLinks.infoTool.translation: Ticki yermed, yesnaqas ijitunen n tikkelt tamezwarut s 12% akken ad yeǧǧ amkan i yiseɣwan. Yettensay s wudem awurman deg uskar n ugzul arurad.

settings.advanced.info.original: Advanced settings for debugging and troubleshooting. Enable debug logging to get detailed information appended to each note for technical support.
settings.advanced.info.translation: Iɣewwaṛen leqqayen i useɣti n tuccḍiwin. Rmed aɣmis n useɣti akken ad ternuḍ talɣut leqqayen i yal tazmilt i tallalt tatiknikt.

settings.advanced.debugLogging.desc.original: Enable detailed debug logs. When enabled, debug information will be appended to each note as a hidden callout for troubleshooting.
settings.advanced.debugLogging.desc.translation: Rmed iɣmisen leqqayen n useɣti. Ticki yermed, talɣut n useɣti ad tettwarnu i yal tazmilt d tanaḍt tuffirt i useɣti n wuguren.

settings.advanced.debugLogging.infoToolt.original: When enabled, debug information will be collected and added to notes as a hidden callout instead of being logged to the console.
settings.advanced.debugLogging.infoToolt.translation: Ticki yermed, talɣut n useɣti ad d-tettwajmeɛ ad ternu ɣer tzemmilin d tanaḍt tuffirt, deg umkan n uɣmis ɣer tdiwennit.

license.modal.title.translation: Turagt n usiɣzef n yiḍrisen YouTube Tubesage

license.modal.loadError.original: Could not load license file. Please check that a license file exists in your plugin directory.
license.modal.loadError.translation: Ur yezmir ara ad d-yali ufaylu n turagt. Senqed ma yella ufaylu n turagt deg ukaram n usiɣzef-ik.

license.required.message.original: You must accept the plugin license before using this feature.
license.required.message.translation: Ilaq ad tqebleḍ turagt n usiɣzef send aseqdec n tmahilt-a.

license.required.instruction.original: Please go to the plugin settings and accept the license terms to continue.
license.required.instruction.translation: Ddu ɣer yiɣewwaṛen n usiɣzef, tqebleḍ tiwtilin n turagt akken ad tkemmleḍ.

license.required.step2.original: Scroll down to the "Community Plugins" section in the sidebar
license.required.step2.translation: Ader ɣer tigzi n yisiɣzaf n temɣiwent deg ufeggag idisan

license.required.step3.original: Find "Tubesage" in the Community Plugins list
license.required.step3.translation: Nadi «Tubesage» deg tebdart n yisiɣzaf n temɣiwent

license.required.step5.original: Toggle "Accept license & disclaimer" to enable the plugin
license.required.step5.translation: Rmed «Qbel turagt & tukksa n tmasit» akken ad yeddu usiɣzef
